protocols.name: source integrity
protocols.require: Kernel, native checker, exact transport/replay bodies, rescope and planner equal 9eb; both frozen old modules equal 9eb. Disclose the only additional change in previously protected count-cert-transport.ts: legacy extraction rethrows original BudgetExpired/WallExpired; malformed metadata remains undefined.

protocols.name: synthetic missing-pair and controls
protocols.require: Run the retained nine tests plus the new min-term transport control (direct and transitive subcases), all ten tests with FULL-only cases enabled, and one strict focused compiler check under the new one-shot Main authority. Record exact passes/skips, not merely exit code.

protocols.name: real Inv* canonical replay
protocols.require: Original source certificates pass unchanged 9eb checkMC first; match retained source goals; reproduce old canonical decline; compare actual rescopeCountProof canonical stage, with no fallback search or altered raw proof declarations

protocols.name: real closing transport into original context
protocols.require: Replay every exact held payload into the same captured ordered 17-law family with original deferToClosing setting; independently check every returned certificate and the complete family if all transports return

protocols.name: explain newly required suppliers
protocols.require: Record old/new hypothesis and law premise sets and which new laws are absent from original 17; do not silently change closing family or claim that an earlier missing-premise refusal is success

protocols.name: remove required supplier
protocols.require: Freeze a successful scoped payload and its target context. Remove a declared added-supplier law only from the target, retain the identical payload, and require replay to refuse on the missing declared premise. Do not re-extract a different scope; duplicate conservative suppliers need not each be logically indispensable. No search.

protocols.name: identity/certificate mutants
protocols.require: Changed owner/premise identity and empty/damaged tree must not yield a checked reduced receipt

protocols.name: hard stop
protocols.require: Under GDP_WORK_FULL=1 GDP_ROWS_SHARED=1, fund legacy prelude and any scope entry tick, then refuse at kernel facts inside legacy rowsAt for a nonempty-lemma certificate. Catch before exiting the active budget; assert no normal return, BudgetExpired phase kernel facts, native refusal trace, and identity-bound workLedger.capacityRefusal receipt. Test direct legacy and scope callers. A mere entry/completion stop is insufficient. Ordinary malformed-metadata decline remains distinct. Baseline swallowing is an expected hard-stop-contract failure, not a same-decline proof result.

protocols.name: inX: no quorum canVote/3 @step
protocols.require: Follow S51-FOCUSED-SPEC.json. Compare exact source hypotheses, generated-row root provenance, law premises AND member-local unused/instance projection. Transport using the unchanged API into the premise-closed held family; never silently undo unused pruning or widen with unheld laws. This optional exact replay is not a prerequisite for the separately authorized combined timed experiment.

recordPerOwner: old and new scope indices and law premises

member-local unused list and exact instance keys/tuples before and after deletion

comparisonRules.monotonicity: Every old reference/law premise must remain in a successful new extraction; explicit incompatible declarations may refuse, not silently weaken
comparisonRules.noSearch: No solver/search counter increment during extraction/replay/transport; no fresh proof generation
comparisonRules.newSuccess: Only if actual original replay/transport returns and unchanged native checks accept the identical statement
comparisonRules.oldFalseNewTrue: IMPROVED, limited to this exact fixture and same statement
comparisonRules.oldFalseNewFalse: SAME_DECLINE / NOT_FIXED; preserve both decline/exception observations
comparisonRules.oldTrueNewFalse: REGRESSION; not accepted as same failure
comparisonRules.missingInput: BLOCKED_MISSING_REPLAY_INPUT; no result or replacement synthetic claim
comparisonRules.familyWidening: Not part of this patch or same-input comparison. A separate captured held pool and explicit authorization are needed to evaluate a different closing family.

launchGate: Exact frozen-replay execution remains blocked until its payloads and separate authority exist. Main separately authorized generalized 9+new-control+compiler ONCE; after green checks and an accepted combined packet D may grant the one combined timed rerun. Missing historical replay data is NOT a prerequisite for that rerun.
claimsNotMade: unconditional end-to-end transport theorem or observed S51 repair
authorizationScope: Only the optional exact frozen-certificate comparisons in this document. Separate Main authority permits one generalized 10-test plus compiler job; a combined timed rerun still needs its own D GO.
